### 🎨 Weapon skins
- The mods menu (C) now has a **Skin** picker next to the attachments — paint any gun that takes attachments
- Three new skins besides the factory finish: **Dune Stalker** (desert camo), **Overdrive** (white, black and safety orange) and **Afterglow** (a gold-to-violet candy fade)
- Every skin is free in every mode, remembered per gun, and other players see your paint job on your gun

### 🔤 Font styles
- New **Font** option in Settings → General: pick from six typeface styles for menus and the HUD — Classic, Tactical, Stencil, Strike, High-tech and Brand

### 🧟 Infection
- A new PvP mode: 15 seconds into the round one player turns into **Patient Zero**, and everyone a mutant kills turns too. Survivors win if anyone is still human when the clock runs out; mutants win when nobody is.
- Any survivor death infects you, a fall or your own grenade included. Players who join mid-round come in as mutants.
- The last survivor standing runs faster.
- Pick a 3, 5 or 8 minute round. It needs at least 3 players, and bots count.

### 🎒 Survivors
- Survivors gear up from the usual buy menu, with the same economy settings as the other modes, and can keep buying all round.
- Sentries and mines are off the menu in Infection.
- Dead mutants drop a little ammo for the gun that killed them.

### 🦑 Mutants
- Mutants are tall, fast tentacled creatures: 250 HP (500 for Patient Zero), running about 60 % faster than a survivor.
- In first person you see two tentacles that writhe and whip out at whatever you strike.
- Their tentacle lash kills a full-health survivor in exactly two hits, wherever it lands.
- Their **Q** is a fireball: it bursts on impact and leaves the ground burning, and it is good for flushing survivors out of cover.
- Bots play both sides.

### 🎬 Story cutscenes
- A new survival world now opens with a cinematic intro. You come to on your back in the forest while a stranger, the Drifter, guns down two of the dead closing in on you with a KR-47.
- He brings you round by a fire. Then gunfire breaks out somewhere far off: his people are in trouble.
- Before he runs off towards the shooting, he leaves you a **map** and tells you to find him on your own.
- A few hours later you wake up alone, with the map in the grass beside you. The campfire is real and still burning, so you can use it.
- The scene is fully voiced, with subtitles, lip-synced dialogue and acted characters.
- In co-op, everyone in the world watches the intro together. Nobody can be hurt while it plays, and creatures leave you alone.
- Each story scene plays once per world and is saved with it.
